name: A Grim Discovery
summary: In Camp Mojache, Krueg Skullsplitter hears that you met tauren in Feralas and names them the Grimtotem. Belgrom has put a bounty on them, and Krueg asks for twenty horns.

sections.title: Word of the Grimtotem
sections.body: You tell Krueg Skullsplitter about the tauren you met in Feralas. He names them as the Grimtotem clan. Belgrom, one of Krueg's masters, has put a bounty on them and takes a keen interest in their kind. Krueg warns you that the Grimtotem are evil and must not be underestimated. He wants twenty horns brought back before they can raze villages or pilfer land.

sections.title: The Horns Delivered
sections.body: Krueg judges the horns good and says you have helped him twice. Belgrom will hear of it as soon as Krueg returns to Orgrimmar.

faq.answer: Krueg Skullsplitter gives it to you in Camp Mojache after you tell him you met tauren in Feralas.

faq.q: Why does Krueg want Grimtotem horns?
faq.answer: Krueg calls the Grimtotem evil and wants them struck before they can raze villages or pilfer land. Belgrom, one of Krueg's masters in Orgrimmar, has also put a bounty on them.
Krueg calls Belgrom one of his masters. Belgrom is interested in the Grimtotem and has put a bounty on them.

faq.q: How many horns does Krueg want?
faq.answer: Krueg wants twenty Grimtotem horns brought to him in Camp Mojache. He would like piles of them if you can manage.
The chain continues with A Grim Discovery, part two.
